popis:
A camp that will test both you and your e-bike. A full day of riding uphill and downhill around Říčany. From Enduro to Trial features. Once again the camp is for everyone who wants to get the most out of their e-bike under the guidance of national and world Trial champions. We'll go through basic technique and head out to test the bikes on natural spots in the area, trails and other places.



LOCATION:

The Říčany area and surroundings offer plenty of places to have fun on legal and tolerated trails. It's mostly forest with rocks.


Parking by the park: Google Maps link

Meeting point in front of Vlasta's house: Google Maps link

(please don't block the street or others' exit from the car park)


You can also get to Tehov by train, from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.



SUITABLE FOR:

Male and female bikers aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (must be a sufficiently skilled rider). In terms of ability, it's suitable for intermediate riders on trails or off-road.



EQUIPMENT:

  1. E-bike in good condition – ideally full-suspension. Longer travel is an advantage.
  2. Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  3. Knee pads – we recommend a back protector
  4. We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  5. Spare clothes.
  6. We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  7. Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.


WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  1. Lunch between trails. Refreshments are of course limited by the travelling.
  2. Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).


SUNDAY – 26 July 2026

10:00 – 13:00 Spot 1

13:00 – 14:30 Lunch break, bike chat, digestion and discussion about anything and everything

14:30 – 17:30 Spot 2

17:30 – 18:00 Camp review, tips and so on …


CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. Availability is shown as text, with details on request. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.


Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).


By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
